svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as pharmacist, wearing a clinical coat. Visible work cue: A pharmacy mortar holds an angled pestle, with a separate two-part capsule above it. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
